title: What's my attendance?

display_messages.content:
Hey there! 🎓

According to the records we have, **no attendance sessions have been logged for you yet**, so there isn’t any attendance data to report at this time. Once your classes start being recorded, you’ll be able to see your attendance percentage and details.

If you think this might be an error or you’ve already attended sessions that aren’t showing up, let me know and we can look into it further!
